description:
*Please let me spend one night with a sexy, handsome, charismatic man.*

Every Christmas, Lee An, the eldest son of the conservative Korean Lee family, would write down his secret sexual fantasy—one he could never share with anyone—in a wish, stuff it into his stocking, and then burn it away unseen. This Christmas returned without fail, and as usual, the only response to his lewd wish note was a sudden surge of work left for him to handle due to his boss's unexpected absence. Feeling restless and unsettled, Ian ended up attending a meeting in his place. There, dressed entirely in red, stood an overwhelmingly handsome man: Hakan Claus. Dragged along by this high-pressure, cold man, Ian barely finished the meeting and stood up. Suddenly, the man asked him what his Christmas wish was this year...

*Last year's Christmas wish... what was it again? Hmm, it was ‘I want to be tied up all Christmas and have sex like an animal,’ right?*

Was this man... really Santa Claus?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
